# shell

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/shell"
```

Package shell is the drawer an app embeds: it owns the terminal size, tabs, focus, status, the overlay stack and the legend rule, and renders the app's panes into a declared layout. The app keeps everything that is its own.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/shell.go#L51-L80>)

Config is everything a Shell needs up front.

```go
type Config struct {
    Layout   layout.Node
    Tabs     []Tab // nil for a single-screen app
    Theme    theme.Resolved
    Title    string
    Subtitle string
    Version  string
    // Header replaces the default one-row header, one string per row. It runs
    // several times a frame, like Tab.Status.
    Header func(ctx Context, width int) []string
    // Can decides which legend entries survive. nil allows everything.
    Can func(Capability) bool
    // LegendLines is how many rows the legend keeps, blank when unfilled, so the
    // panes hold their size as the keys change: 1 for a compact footer, 2 (the
    // default, also for 0 or less) when the app has many keys.
    LegendLines int
    // Actions are active on every screen, before the tab's or SetActions's.
    Actions []Action
    // StatusTTL is how long the palette's errors and Copy's result stay on the
    // status row; 5s when zero. An app with its own banner clock passes that.
    StatusTTL time.Duration
    // Spinner is what Busy shows; without frames it turns spinner.Dot's at its
    // own Every. A test sets an Every of a nanosecond, never to wait on a tick.
    Spinner spinner.Spinner
    // Transition, when set, is the effect played over the panes as the user
    // changes tab, given the tab left and the tab shown. SlideTabs is one.
    Transition func(from, to int) animation.Effect
    // Clipboard is what Copy writes to; nil means the system clipboard.
    Clipboard func(string) error
}
```

<a name="Pane"></a>
## type [Pane](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/view.go#L80-L87>)

Pane is what the app hands the shell for one leaf: a title for the border and a body drawn into the inner rect the shell computed.

```go
type Pane struct {
    Title  string
    Right  string        // at the end of the top edge, while it fits beside Title
    Bottom string        // at the end of the bottom edge, while it fits
    Scroll layout.Scroll // a scrollbar's thumb down the right edge, from list.Scroll and the like
    Accent color.Color   // the edges' colour, focused or not; nil keeps the theme's
    Body   func(inner layout.Rect) string
}
```


<a name="Tab"></a>
## type [Tab](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/shell.go#L44-L48>)

Tab answers for one screen of the app: its name in the strip, the status text and the keys for where the user is. Status and Actions run several times a frame, so keep them cheap and free of side effects. A Tab that is a value is read as given: hand it back through SetTabs when it changes.

```go
type Tab interface {
    Name() string
    Status(ctx Context) string
    Actions(ctx Context) []Action
}
```
